    if np.size(bins) == 0:
        return np.array([])

    if item <= 0:
        return np.array([-np.inf] * len(bins))

    delta = bins - item
    valid = delta >= 0
    space_remain = np.where(valid, delta - item, -np.inf)
    space_before = np.where(valid, delta, -np.inf)

    scores = 1.0 / (space_remain + 1e-10) + 1.0 / (space_before + 1e-10)

    scores[bins < item + 1e-5] += 150.0  # Avoid fragmentation
